thread:
Sarah: Customer AcmePayments upgraded python-sdk from 1.41.3 -> 1.42.0 last night and are seeing 401 auth errors + duplicate billing events when calls retry. They say streaming stops emitting and they relied on `stop` param which now behaves differently. Logs attached.
Ben: Can you paste the minimal repro and the exact pip freeze + call they used? Also which auth method (api key, oauth)?
Sarah: Repro steps from customer:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model='gpt-4-small', input='summarize this', stop=['\n'])
print(resp.text)
```
They pinned to 1.42.0. Env: standard API key. Observed behavior: sometimes response empty, sometimes gets 401, and our billing shows retries charged twice.
Meena: Two quick asks: did the customer set an idempotency key (Idempotency-Key/X-Redwood-Idempotency)? And do we have server-side request IDs for the duplicates? If retries are retried client-side + infra-side we can double-execute.
Chris: Note: 1.42 changed default retry behavior to `retry_backend='auto'` which enables urllib3/request-level retries in addition to our client-layer retry. That can double-send on some connection resets. We added a release note but customer missed it. Workaround: pin to 1.41.3 or explicitly set `client = RedwoodClient(..., retry_backend='legacy')` or set `REDWOOD_PY_RETRY_BEHAVIOR=legacy` env var.
Ben: Can Sarah share the raw request/response headers from the failing calls? If we can see missing idempotency header or `x-request-id` we can correlate duplicates. Also want the SDK call stack when 401 happens.
Sarah: Customer sent server logs showing two requests within ~200ms with same payload and different internal charge IDs. Headers show no Idempotency-Key. They included our request-id `req_7f9a3c` on both responses. Patchwork: sent them pin command: `pip install 'redwood-python==1.41.3'` and add header `headers={'Idempotency-Key': uuid4().hex}` to their wrapper. They confirmed lower error rate but want permanent fix.
Meena: Recommend we escalate to eng-runtime to guard: SDK should not enable two retry layers by default. Also we need an alert rule for doubled charge events correlated with SDK upgrade. I'll file an ops follow-up.
Ben: I'll open an internal bug: if SDK detects `retry_backend='auto'` plus connection-level retries present, warn the user and default to not duplicating retries. Also add docs about idempotency header for mutating endpoints. Assigning to eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: Ticket TICKET-5421 opened: "py-sdk-1.42-double-retries-idempotency-guard" assigned to Ben, priority P2.
Sarah: I'll reply to the customer with rollback + header workaround and ask for any additional logs. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
